description: "Ceremonial of Hasjelti Dailjis and Mythical Sand Painting of the Navajo Indians" by James Stevenson is a detailed account of Navajo ceremonial practices, likely written in the late 19th century. The work meticulously documents a nine-day healing ceremony attended by Navajo community members, emphasizing the cultural significance of sand painting and its role in spiritual healing.
